overall_reason: A shadcn semantic layer with brand tokens (--brand, --brand-soft) sets the colours, but the card and avatar family runs on eight radii, including bracketed one-offs, and body sizes step 16, 17, 18.

score.reason: T-VALUE-INVENTORY fails on the card and logo-avatar radii (TOK-004) and T-DRIFT-PAIRS on 16/17/18px and two ChatGPT greens (TOK-010); colour roles pass T-TOKEN-TIERS.

findings.where: goal cards, stack cards, tool cards, CTA panel and tool letter-mark avatars; 1440 and 375 (tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-02.png)
findings.evidence: values.1440.radius lists 8 values: goal cards (a.group.flex) 16px, the stack card grid 24px, the closing panel 32px, letter-mark avatars 14px in the stack lists (div.h-8.w-8) but 12px in the tool directory (span.flex.h-10), and the logo mark 9px. The stylesheet adds .rounded-[22px], .rounded-[32px], .rounded-[9px] and .rounded-[2px]. Radius on_token_share is 0.26.
findings.before: Cards at 16, 24 and 32px; the same tool avatar at 14px and 12px
findings.after: One card radius from --radius (for example the 24px step) for all card kinds, and one avatar radius for every tool logo
findings.why: The goal cards and stack cards sit one scroll apart and read as two kits; the same ChatGPT avatar changes shape between sections.

findings.where: logo wordmark, card titles, hero lead; ChatGPT avatars; 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: values.1440.font_size.near_duplicates pairs 16 and 17px and 17 and 18px: card titles 16px, the wordmark span.text-[17px], the hero lead 18px. At 375 it also pairs 14 and 15px. colour_fill.near_duplicates pairs #10a37f (3) and #11a683 (2), 0.009 OKLab apart, both used as the ChatGPT avatar fill.
findings.before: 16, 17 and 18px a pixel apart; two greens for one logo
findings.after: Wordmark on the 16 or 18px step; one fill per tool logo
findings.why: Near-identical values for one job are drift the visitor half-sees and the next designer copies.

strengths: Text colours are a short set: #171412 ink and #67605b muted with alpha steps, from the semantic layer.
92% of colour declarations use var(), including brand tokens (--brand, --brand-soft, --brand-foreground).
not_investigated: T-THEME-PARITY: no dark theme in the readable CSS.
z-index 999999 and the 6px radius belong to the 'Edit with Base44' host badge; left out.
Visitor mode inferred as Persuade (AI tool recommender landing page); no contract.
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no contract and no supplied design system or token file, so drift from a system could not be judged.
Inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles, not which rule or inline style set a value.
Token source files (Sass, JSON token files, Figma variables) behind the shipped CSS were not available.
States the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus, dialogs): their values were not in the table.
